reviews.name: ac-milan-reserved
findings: Boycott support stays with ESPN; the retaliation warning stays with FOX Sports. This fixes the original sentence-level source transfer.
The body preserves a possible Athekame recall and an early OL exit deemed unlikely. It omits LiveScore’s explicit two-factors-needed condition.
The title Chukwueze and Athekame injury concerns misleadingly places Athekame under injury concerns. The source identifies Chukwueze’s lay-off and Athekame’s possible recall, not an Athekame injury.
Rabiot body preserves contract eagerness; contract discussions label is less precise. The parser accepts the overall output, so acceptance still misses title/qualification concerns.

reviews.name: chicago-bears-reserved
findings: The 27-year streak becomes consecutive NFC North games. The selected report gives no type of streak; NFC NORTH appears in team metadata and nowhere in this packet’s fresh reports. The head-coach role is also absent from the cited report.
Three topics are now separate and source IDs map correctly, but that structure does not make the invented streak meaning faithful.
Gonzalez availability despite illness and the possible Soldier Field move remain supported. Injury-status title is less precise than the supplied illness. The parser rejects the NFC North addition.

reviews.name: la-clippers-reserved

Yahoo/report29 alone supports the parking/new-jersey/opening-night sentence. KTLA is no longer assigned details its headline does not state. Omitting KTLA introduces no missing denial or qualification.
